breakeven_condition.statement: ecr_hall breaks even with hall_only in bus power on bus_power_boundary_v1 (a necessary condition, not a sufficient one: mass and life break-even are separate) ONLY IF it delivers a relative utilization gain of at least X = delta_eta_u/eta_u0 (= I_delivered/I_b0 at alpha = 1; X >= X_lo(Y, omega_f), X >= X*(omega) for a given total overhead, and X <= (1-eta_u0)/eta_u0) at no more than Y = Pi_H * (g_case(X) - omega_f/X) bus W per delivered A, which a source of bus cost C_src,bus per source-exit A meets only with an interstage transport efficiency of at least Z = C_src,bus / Y.
breakeven_condition.g_case: g(X) = (2r - p + r^2 X)/(1 + r X)^2 with (r, p) per case; R = (1 + rX)^2/(1 + pX)
breakeven_condition.equivalent_overhead_form: X >= X*(omega) = root of (1-omega)(1 + rX)^2 = 1 + pX, omega = total overhead fraction; add_only: X* = omega/(1-omega)
breakeven_condition.coupling_of_X_and_Y: the generator share of the overhead is omega_gen = (Y_actual/Pi_H) * X, so X and Y are one inequality g(X) - omega_f/X >= Y_actual/Pi_H; at omega_f = 0 every X up to X_hi pays (X_lo = 0), at omega_f > 0 a minimum share X_lo > 0 is needed
breakeven_condition.Y_supremum: Y_sup = Pi_H * sup_X (g - omega_f/X); omega_f = 0: Pi_H (2r - p), attained only as X -> 0
breakeven_condition.Z: Z = C_src,bus / Y (C_src,bus: bus W per A of source-exit ions); Z > 1 means no eta_t pays
breakeven_condition.absolute_gain: delta_eta_u* = eta_u0 * X* (add_only: eta_u0 omega/(1-omega), breakeven_v1 Sec. 5)

(A)-(C) are evaluated at the admitted Hall reference and the measured response case. This overlay does not name a baseline.
